newsitem.title: USA: S.C. drill sergeant cleared of harassment charges.
newsitem.headline: S.C. drill sergeant cleared of harassment charges.

text.p: A former Army drill sergeant was found not guilty Friday on four counts of sexual harassment of a trainee, said a spokeswoman for Fort Jackson, the Army's largest basic training base.
A seven-member military jury deliberated less than two hours before returning the not guilty verdict in favour of Sergeant First Class Alfred Ray Palma.
Palma had been charged with two counts of consensual sodomy and one count each of adultery and improper association with a woman trainee.
More than 500 of the service's 2,000 drill sergeants are stationed at Fort Jackson, which trains about 40,000 soldiers each year.
